prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web-page north-star decision comp for a developer portfolio project case study, exact 3:2 landscape composition intended for 1536×1024 output.

Input images:
- Image 1 is the established Marc Mansour portfolio visual-identity reference. Use it only for the Activity Ledger chrome, midnight-paper palette, cobalt rules, Bitter-like slab-serif display character, Source Code Pro-like labels, subtle 32px ruled paper texture, nearly square dossier geometry, and sparse lime plus signal-red proof annotations. Do not copy its homepage composition or content.
- Images 2, 3, and 4 are official Savyy iOS product screenshots. Preserve their recognizable real Savyy UI appearance, dark French personal-finance screens, indigo/lavender accents, white device shells, and actual screen content. Use these as product evidence rather than inventing a dashboard.

Primary request: Design the first 1024px-tall viewport of a working portfolio case-study page titled exactly “One Product, All the Way Through.” The result must unmistakably be Marc Mansour’s portfolio case study about building Savyy solo—not a Savyy marketing landing page, fintech dashboard, poster, or generic hero-card layout.

Scene/backdrop: Midnight recycled working paper, deep navy raised stock, faint horizontal ledger ruling, hairline cobalt-blue structure, one restrained red proof-mark gesture, and a few tiny lime data marks. Desktop web-page chrome is integrated into the ledger: a slim top register with “MARC MANSOUR” at left, “PROJECTS” visibly active among minimal portfolio navigation, and a small book/page index at right.

Composition/framing:
- Exact 1536×1024 landscape page view, edge-to-edge desktop website screenshot, no browser chrome and no external margin.
- The first fold uses an assertive asymmetric two-column editorial layout connected by continuous cobalt rules, not floating cards.
- Left half: a monumental, left-anchored slab-serif founder statement occupying most of the column: “One serious product. All the way through.” Keep those exact words and punctuation. Below it, the supporting line appears exactly: “I built Savyy alone, from product and interface to banking, AI, mobile, infrastructure, and security.”
- Right half: a large overlapping web-and-mobile Savyy specimen built as physical dossier evidence. Use a broad dark desktop browser sheet behind and one or two tilted white-shell iPhones in front. The phones must visibly reuse the official Savyy screenshots’ real French UI—overview/patrimoine, analysis/menu, or export screens. The desktop sheet should feel like the same real Savyy product system adapted to web, using the official screenshots as visual evidence; keep it specific and restrained, never a generic analytics dashboard. Add tiny dossier labels such as “SAVYY / PRODUCT EVIDENCE” and “WEB + MOBILE”, paper clips or square crop marks only if subtle.
- A thin first-fold proof register spans beneath the hero and names exactly: “SOLO FULL STACK”, “4,000+ BANKS”, and “WEB · IOS · ANDROID”. Treat these as concise Source Code Pro-style indexed facts, not oversized stat cards.
- Primary action is exactly “OPEN SAVYY.APP”, in a nearly square cobalt ledger control with directional arrow. Secondary App Store / Google Play badges may appear small and subordinate.
- At the bottom edge, visibly reveal the start of the next section below the fold as three ruled columns labeled exactly “PRODUCT / SYSTEMS / RELEASES”, making this read as a continuing portfolio case study.

Style/medium: Production-quality editorial website screenshot, precise responsive web UI, tactile analyst’s dossier, high legibility, crisp typesetting, disciplined baseline grid, physical-paper overlap only around the product specimen. Bitter-like sturdy slab-serif thesis, humanist sans supporting copy, Source Code Pro-like uppercase labels.

Color palette: night paper #0B111B, raised navy #111C2A and #192636, mineral text #EDF3F0, blueprint cobalt #78A8FF, sparse data lime #B9E84B, one signal-red #FF7D86 proof mark. Savyy screens keep their authentic dark charcoal, indigo, teal, lavender, and white device framing from the input references.

Text (verbatim):
“One Product, All the Way Through.”
“One serious product. All the way through.”
“I built Savyy alone, from product and interface to banking, AI, mobile, infrastructure, and security.”
“SOLO FULL STACK”
“4,000+ BANKS”
“WEB · IOS · ANDROID”
“OPEN SAVYY.APP”
“PRODUCT / SYSTEMS / RELEASES”

Constraints: Use only supplied factual claims. Preserve official Savyy screenshot identity and recognizable screen content. Keep the portfolio chrome and product specimen visually distinct. Strong working-page hierarchy, square dossier geometry, continuous rules, subtle real paper grain. Ensure all required English text is clearly readable and spelled exactly.

Avoid: invented users, balances beyond those already visible inside official screenshots, revenue, awards, testimonials, performance metrics, fake growth charts, generic dashboard UI, crypto styling, neon glow, gradients, glassmorphism, pill-heavy controls, rounded bento grid, centered hero, overscaled metric cards, mobile-app landing-page conventions, stock photography, illustration, or decorative poster composition.
